rows.grounds: compound of śrī, svacchanda, and ādi

items.question: Which procedure is to be followed here too?
premises: Here too all procedure is to be followed.
Śrī Svacchanda etc. names the procedure.
items.inference: The verse directs following all Śrī Svacchanda procedures here.
items.plain_english: Here too, all the procedure of Śrī Svacchanda and the rest is to be followed.
